description: Phase 2 Mobile UX — Invisible-until-needed terminal layout for phone screens with minimal status bar, tab dot indicators, swipe navigation, extra keys row, PTY session reconnect overlay, and safe-area support

On mobile (< 768px / isMobile()): hide the full toolbar (TerminalTabs + action buttons row) and show MobileStatusBar instead
On desktop (>= 768px): show existing toolbar normally, hide MobileStatusBar
Status bar uses `pt-[max(0.25rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))]` for notch devices

Other tabs: 4px dots colored by connection status (--color-success for connected, --color-error for disconnected, --color-text-muted for idle)
Only render dots when 2+ tabs exist — single tab shows no dots (cleanest status bar)
Beyond 8 tabs, truncate dots and show count badge (e.g., `+3` in text-[9px])
Tapping the dots area dispatches an event to open a full tab list bottom sheet overlay
Integrate TabDots into MobileStatusBar component
`cd ui && npm run check` passes
`cd ui && npm run build` passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: The TabDots component receives props: tabs (TerminalTab[]), activeTabId (string|null), onTapDots (() => void). Render using flexbox with gap-[3px]. Active dot uses `w-1.5 h-1.5` (6px), others use `w-1 h-1` (4px). Status-to-color mapping: connected -> bg-success, connecting -> bg-warning animate-pulse, disconnected -> bg-text-muted, error -> bg-error. The tab list bottom sheet (opened on tap) can be a simple list of tab names with status colors and a close button — reuse the bottom sheet pattern from TerminalPrefsPanel.svelte.

userStories.title: Swipe tab navigation on mobile
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want to swipe left/right on the terminal area to switch between tabs, so I don't need a visible tab bar.
acceptanceCriteria: CONTEXT7 RESEARCH: Use Context7 MCP tool to query Svelte 5 docs for 'touch events swipe gesture handler ontouchstart ontouchmove ontouchend'. Use latest patterns found.
Add horizontal swipe detection to the TerminalPane container div
Swipe left -> next tab (terminalState.nextTab())
Swipe right -> previous tab (terminalState.prevTab())
Minimum swipe distance: 50px horizontally, max 30px vertically (to distinguish from scroll)
Must NOT conflict with xterm.js scroll/text selection touch events

Approach: attach touchstart/touchend listeners to the container div (NOT the xterm canvas — xterm handles its own touch events). The container div wraps the canvas but the swipe gesture is detected at the container level
Only active on mobile (guard with isMobile())
Visual feedback: brief flash or subtle animation on tab switch (optional, not required)
`cd ui && npm run check` passes
`cd ui && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: File: `ui/src/lib/components/terminal/TerminalPane.svelte`. The container div already has ontouchend for double-tap detection. Add ontouchstart to capture the start position, then in ontouchend calculate the delta. Guard: only process swipe if `isMobile()` and the horizontal delta exceeds 50px while vertical delta is under 30px. Import isMobile from '$lib/state/mobile.svelte.js'. Call terminalState.nextTab()/prevTab() which already exist. The double-tap gesture (300ms threshold) should still work — swipe detection uses distance, double-tap uses timing, so they don't conflict.

userStories.title: Extra keys row for mobile terminal input
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want an extra row of terminal-specific keys (ESC, TAB, CTL, ALT, arrows, pipe) above the on-screen keyboard, so I can send special keys that phone keyboards don't have.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `ui/src/lib/components/terminal/ExtraKeysRow.svelte` — a thin row of terminal-specific keys
Keys: ESC, TAB, CTL, ALT, ↑, ↓, ←, →, | (pipe)
CTL and ALT are toggle modifier keys: tap CTL, it highlights, then next key tap sends Ctrl+[key]. Auto-clears after one keypress.
Visual: highlighted background when modifier is active (bg-accent/20 or similar)
Each key tap writes the appropriate escape sequence to the PTY via the parent's injectInput callback
Key mappings: ESC -> '\x1b', TAB -> '\t', arrows -> '\x1b[A/B/C/D', pipe -> '|', CTL+c -> '\x03', etc.
Height: ~28px, matches terminal theme (bg-surface-raised, border-border)
Only visible on mobile — controlled by parent based on isMobile()

Create `ui/src/lib/platform/keyboard.ts` — exports a reactive `keyboardVisible` state using visualViewport resize heuristic (>150px height decrease = keyboard shown). This is the web fallback; Tauri will override this in Phase 4.
ExtraKeysRow appears between terminal and keyboard ONLY when keyboard is visible
`cd ui && npm run check` passes
`cd ui && npm run build` passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: The ExtraKeysRow needs an onKeyPress callback prop that takes a string (the escape sequence to inject). The parent (+page.svelte or TerminalPane) calls paneRefs[activeTabId].injectInput(sequence). For CTL modifier: maintain local $state `ctlActive` boolean. When CTL is tapped, set true. When any other key is tapped, if ctlActive, convert the key to its Ctrl equivalent (e.g., 'c' -> '\x03'). Same for ALT (prepend '\x1b'). The keyboard.ts module: use `$state` for keyboardVisible, set up visualViewport resize listener in an init function called from onMount. Heuristic: store initial viewport height, if current height < (initial - 150px) then keyboard is visible. Also listen for focusin/focusout on input elements as secondary signal for iOS Safari.

userStories.title: PTY session disconnect/reconnect overlay
userStories.description: As a mobile user, when my PTY session drops (phone screen off, network change), I want to see my previous terminal output with a reconnect prompt overlay instead of a blank screen.
acceptanceCriteria: When a PTY session disconnects unexpectedly (not intentional disconnect), show a reconnect overlay on top of the terminal pane
Overlay shows: 'Session disconnected' message with two buttons: [Reconnect] and [New Session]
The serialized terminal buffer (from US-007 Phase 1) remains visible behind the overlay — user can see their last output
Reconnect button: calls connect() which starts a fresh shell (PTY sessions cannot be resumed) but preserves the visible scrollback
New Session button: calls clear() then connect() for a clean start
Overlay only appears on unexpected disconnect (status changes to 'disconnected' or 'error' while the connection was previously 'connected')
Overlay disappears automatically when connection is re-established
Overlay is semi-transparent dark background with centered content, themed to match terminal
Works on both mobile and desktop
`cd ui && npm run check` passes
`cd ui && npm run build` passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: File: `ui/src/lib/components/terminal/TerminalPane.svelte`. Add a `showReconnectOverlay` $state boolean. Set it to true in the reconnection failure path (when max reconnect attempts exceeded) or when socket closes unexpectedly. Set it to false when connect() is called or when status becomes 'connected'. The overlay is a div positioned `absolute inset-0` over the terminal container with `bg-background/80 flex items-center justify-center z-10`. Content: icon, message, two Button components. The terminal output is still visible behind the semi-transparent overlay because the serialized buffer was restored.

userStories.notes: This story audits and fixes safe-area support across the app. The viewport meta tag already has `viewport-fit=cover` (app.html:5).
